# `bs move`

- **Usage:** `bs move [FLAGS] <ID> <DESTINATION>`

Move a bit to a shelf or a new shelf/name ID without overwriting

## Arguments
- **`<ID>`**
- **`<DESTINATION>`**

## Flags
- **`--title <TITLE>`**
- **`--tags <TAGS>`** — Replace tags with a comma-separated list
- **`--set <SET>`** — Set a literal string KEY=VALUE (repeatable)
- **`--set-json <SET_JSON>`** — Set a typed JSON value KEY=JSON (repeatable)
- **`--unset <UNSET>`** — Remove a metadata field (repeatable)
- **`--dry-run`** — Validate and preview without changing files
- **`-h --help`** — Print help
